hunks.baseline: The glow pouring from the Sword Force was beautiful—and precise. I could feel a destructive power in it that looked ready to split not only the spearhead, but my body itself, in two.
hunks.sol: The glow pouring from the Sword Force was beautiful—and unerring. I could feel the devastating power in it, enough to split not only my spearhead but my body itself in two.

hunks.baseline: *It's over.*
hunks.sol: *It’s over.*

hunks.baseline: I had done my best. It would be a lie to say I had no regrets at all, but that wouldn't change the outcome.
hunks.sol: I had done my best. It would be a lie to say I had no regrets at all, but that wouldn’t change the outcome.

hunks.baseline: All I could do was smash into it with everything I had left.
hunks.sol: All I could do was meet it with everything I had left.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder's eyes flew wide.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: A freak of unknown identity had risen at lightning speed and driven a dagger into his dantian.
hunks.sol: A mysterious figure had sprung up with lightning speed and driven a dagger into his dantian.

hunks.baseline: “You should've struck a lethal acupoint.”
hunks.sol: “You should’ve struck a lethal acupoint.”

hunks.baseline: But he wasn't.
hunks.sol: But he wasn’t.

hunks.baseline: The freak had only been waiting, with extreme patience, for his moment—the moment he could avenge his child.
hunks.sol: He had merely been waiting with extraordinary patience for the right moment—the moment he could avenge his child.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder cried out like a scream.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder screamed.

hunks.baseline: The instant Lee Cheonbaek burst into maniacal laughter, my spearhead punched into his back.
hunks.sol: The instant Lee Cheonbaek burst into wild laughter, my spearhead punched into his back.

hunks.baseline: I had really died and come back. I'd even seen a vision of going through hell's immigration, sharing a passionate hug with King Yama, and snapping a commemorative photo together.
hunks.sol: I had really died and come back. I’d even seen a vision of going through immigration into hell, sharing a passionate hug with Yama, and snapping a commemorative photo together.

hunks.baseline: If it hadn't been for Lee Cheonbaek, that vision would have become reality.
hunks.sol: If it hadn’t been for Lee Cheonbaek, that vision would have become reality.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to close Lee Cheonbaek's eyes so he could go in peace, but there was still work to do.
hunks.sol: I wanted to close Lee Cheonbaek’s eyes so he could rest in peace, but there was still work to do.

hunks.baseline: “So live a little nicer. Come on.”
hunks.sol: “Should’ve lived a decent life, then. Just a little.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder let out a faint laugh at that. He looked horrific.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder gave a quiet laugh. He looked horrific.

hunks.baseline: One Annihilation had swallowed his remaining arm, and it hadn't stopped there—it had punched a hole the size of a fist through his chest.
hunks.sol: One Annihilation had swallowed his remaining arm, and it hadn’t stopped there—it had punched a hole the size of a fist through his chest.

hunks.baseline: “The old folks I know spend their later years enjoying their grandchildren's antics. They're not old bastards like you, running around trying to kill their own grandchildren.”
hunks.sol: “The old folks I know spend their twilight years enjoying their grandchildren’s antics. They don’t run around trying to kill them like you, you old bastard.”

hunks.baseline: “Why, you brat! Play at being a grandson first, then say something like that.”
hunks.sol: “Why, you brat! Try acting like a grandson before you say something like that.”

hunks.baseline: He laughed heartily. He looked hollow, and yet relieved, as if he had finally shaken everything off.
hunks.sol: He laughed heartily. He looked deflated, yet relieved, as though he had finally let go of everything.

hunks.baseline: “Taekyung is a good kid. If you had opened your heart first, the two of you might have had a good grandfather-grandson relationship.”
hunks.sol: “Taekyung is a good kid. If you had opened your heart first, the two of you might have been close as grandfather and grandson.”

hunks.baseline: “I'm considering it.”
hunks.sol: “I’m considering it.”

hunks.baseline: “You'd better finish considering it quickly. I don't have much time left.”
hunks.sol: “You’d better finish considering it quickly. I don’t have much time left.”

hunks.baseline: Even now, as he talked as if nothing were wrong, blood poured like a waterfall from the severed stumps of both arms and from his lower abdomen.
hunks.sol: Even now, as he talked as though nothing were wrong, blood poured like a waterfall from the severed stumps of both arms and from his lower abdomen.

hunks.baseline: On top of that, there was the backlash from drawing up his innate qi.
hunks.sol: On top of that, there was the backlash from drawing out his innate qi.

hunks.baseline: “You look like you're having a hard time.”
hunks.sol: “You look like you’re suffering.”

hunks.baseline: “No. I'm getting comfortable.”
hunks.sol: “No. I’m growing comfortable.”

hunks.baseline: “In truth, perhaps I've been tired for a very long time.”
hunks.sol: “In truth, perhaps I’ve been tired for a very long time.”

hunks.baseline: I muttered, appalled.
hunks.sol: I muttered in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “You did all that, and now you're coming out with this?”
hunks.sol: “You did all that, and now you’re coming out with this?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung sent me a look of mild reproach, but the Head Elder did not seem offended. A breathy laugh leaked from behind the lips he had pressed shut.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung sent me a mildly reproachful look, but the Head Elder did not seem offended. A breathy laugh escaped his closed lips.

hunks.baseline: “Puh-huh. Yes, you're right. Just think of it as a senile old man's bullshit.”
hunks.sol: “Puh-huh. Yes, you’re right. Just think of it as a senile old man’s bullshit.”

hunks.baseline: “What? It's not like I said anything wrong.”
hunks.sol: “What? It’s not like I said anything wrong.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder watched Jin Wikyung and me bicker with a fading gaze.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder watched Jin Wikyung and me bicker through fading eyes.

hunks.baseline: “We had a time like yours too. Yes. There was definitely a time when we were like that.”
hunks.sol: “There was a time when we were like you two. Yes. There certainly was.”

hunks.baseline: But he no longer had time left even to linger over those memories.
hunks.sol: But he no longer had time to linger over those memories.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder staggered after vomiting what had to be a bowlful of blood.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder staggered after vomiting what looked like a whole bowlful of blood.

hunks.baseline: He was at death's door. Every capillary in his eyes had burst, and the blood pouring from his body had long since pooled at his feet.
hunks.sol: He was at death’s door. Every capillary in his eyes had burst, and the blood pouring from his body had long since pooled at his feet.

hunks.baseline: *He's really dying? That Head Elder?*
hunks.sol: *He’s really dying? That Head Elder?*

hunks.baseline: Everyone dies.
hunks.sol: Everyone died.

hunks.baseline: But the Head Elder's death was something I had never even been able to imagine.
hunks.sol: But the Head Elder’s death was something I had never even been able to imagine.

hunks.baseline: “Because I want to tell those who left before me… that I did my best.”
hunks.sol: “Because I want to tell those who went before me… that I did my best.”

hunks.baseline: “Regrets?”
hunks.sol: “Any regrets?”

hunks.baseline: A single gust of wind passed, and the Head Elder's knees—which had never seemed capable of buckling—touched the ground.
hunks.sol: A single gust of wind passed, and the Head Elder’s knees—which had seemed incapable of ever buckling—touched the ground.

hunks.baseline: A peaceful smile rose on his wrinkled face.
hunks.sol: A peaceful smile appeared on his wrinkled face.

hunks.baseline: For a very brief moment, silence fell.
hunks.sol: For one brief moment, silence fell.

hunks.baseline: Everyone who had survived was shouting my name.
hunks.sol: Every survivor was shouting my name.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng gave a quiet snort.
hunks.sol: Wipeng gave a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “That is because my lord wanted it that way. A mere Third Young Master killing him? It's laughable.”
hunks.sol: “That is because my lord wanted it that way. A mere Third Young Master killing him? It’s laughable.”

hunks.baseline: He was leaning diagonally against a heap of corpses.
hunks.sol: He was leaning at an angle against a heap of corpses.

hunks.baseline: A sword wound split him on a slant from about the shoulder to the waist, and blood poured from it in torrents.
hunks.sol: A sword wound split him diagonally from the shoulder to the waist, and blood poured from it in torrents.

hunks.baseline: “No. This old man's end was decided long ago. A very painful death.”
hunks.sol: “No. This old man’s end was decided long ago. A very painful death.”

hunks.baseline: “I won't allow it.”
hunks.sol: “I won’t allow it.”

hunks.sol: Blood poured from all seven of the First Elder’s orifices. His eyes rolled back, and his entire body convulsed.

hunks.baseline: By the time Wipeng hurried over, the First Elder's breath had already stopped.
hunks.sol: By the time Wipeng hurried over, the First Elder had already stopped breathing.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng carved the single word that had become the First Elder's last deep into his mind.
hunks.sol: Wipeng carved the name that had become the First Elder’s dying words deep into his mind.

hunks.baseline: The only clue the First Elder had left behind.
hunks.sol: It was the only clue the First Elder had left behind.

hunks.baseline: Wipeng stared at the dead man's face with complicated feelings, then turned away.
hunks.sol: Wipeng stared at the dead man’s face with mixed emotions, then turned away.

hunks.baseline: Weapons fell weakly to the ground.
hunks.sol: Weapons fell limply to the ground.

hunks.baseline: It was the end of the war.
hunks.sol: The war was over.

hunks.baseline: Where there were the dead, there were also those who had lived.
hunks.sol: Where there were the dead, there were also survivors.

hunks.baseline: The Sect Leader of the Gunggui Sect,[^1] Jin Chung, was one of them. He had climbed to the top of the cliff before the battle began.
hunks.sol: Jin Chung, Sect Leader of the Gunggui Sect,[^1] was one of them. He had climbed to the top of the cliff before the battle began.

hunks.baseline: “How hollow.”
hunks.sol: “How futile.”

hunks.baseline: The result was horrific.
hunks.sol: The result had been disastrous.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder he had served as his lord, the Elders he had called brother, and the Sect Leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi had all died.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder he had served as his lord, the Elders he had treated as brothers, and the Sect Leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi were all dead.

hunks.baseline: The survivors' last desperate struggle had ended as well.
hunks.sol: The survivors’ last desperate struggle was over as well.

hunks.baseline: Fifty martial artists of Gunggwimun were waiting for his orders.
hunks.sol: Fifty martial artists of the Gunggui Sect were waiting for his orders.

hunks.baseline: An invisible stir ran through them.
hunks.sol: A subtle ripple of agitation passed through them.

hunks.baseline: “This fight is already over. I will not force you to sacrifice yourselves. Leave by this road. Scatter as widely as you can and get out of Shanxi. If you do, you may at least save your lives.”
hunks.sol: “This fight is already over. I will not force you to sacrifice yourselves. Leave at once. Scatter as widely as you can and get out of Shanxi. If you do, you may at least save your lives.”

hunks.baseline: The confusion lasted only a moment before the martial artist's voice began to tremble with feeling.
hunks.sol: His confusion lasted only a moment before his voice began to tremble with emotion.

hunks.baseline: *If I followed them, the Jin Family of Taiyuan would hunt them relentlessly.*
hunks.sol: *If I went with them, the Jin Family of Taiyuan would hunt them relentlessly.*

hunks.baseline: If the grand scheme had succeeded, they would have become the backbone of Shanxi's Murim.
hunks.sol: If the grand scheme had succeeded, they would have become the backbone of Shanxi’s Murim.

hunks.baseline: “Do you not understand how this is going?”
hunks.sol: “Do you not understand what’s happening?”

hunks.sol: “Even if we die, we will stay with you, Sect Leader.”

hunks.baseline: “You brat!”
hunks.sol: “You fool!”

hunks.sol: The martial artist who had stepped forward first slammed his forehead against the stone ground.

hunks.baseline: Talk of *them* was a secret known only to the eight at the top.
hunks.sol: Talk of *them* was a secret known only to the eight leaders.

hunks.baseline: To speak those words aloud was no different from deciding to share his final moments with his disciples.
hunks.sol: Speaking those words aloud was no different from deciding to share his final moments with his disciples.

hunks.baseline: *This too must be heaven's will.*
hunks.sol: *This too must be heaven’s will.*

hunks.baseline: Thuck!
hunks.sol: Crunch!

hunks.baseline: Jin Chung stared at the martial artist with a blank look.
hunks.sol: Jin Chung stared blankly at the martial artist.

hunks.baseline: The shock was so great he could not even feel pain.
hunks.sol: The shock was so great he could not even feel the pain.

hunks.baseline: The martial artist pulled his hand from Jin Chung's chest.
hunks.sol: The martial artist pulled his hand from Jin Chung’s chest.

hunks.baseline: A glow brighter than moonlight clung to it—a blood-red Force that inspired dread just to look at.
hunks.sol: A glow brighter than moonlight clung to it—a blood-red Force so ominous that the mere sight of it inspired dread.

hunks.baseline: “You already know, so why ask? Oh, and about what you just said—I'll give you a simple answer.”
hunks.sol: “You already know, so why ask? Oh, and about what you just said—I’ll give you a simple answer.”

hunks.baseline: The martial artist's smile deepened.
hunks.sol: The martial artist’s smile deepened.

hunks.baseline: “Why would we step forward? Your role ends right here.”
hunks.sol: “Why would we step forward? This is as far as your role goes.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Chung's eyes flew wide.
hunks.sol: Jin Chung’s eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: “Don't look at me like you've been used. Forgotten who got you out of that hell alive?”
hunks.sol: “Don’t look at me like you’ve been used. Have you forgotten who got you out of that hell alive?”

hunks.baseline: The endless army of the Demonic Cult surging in.
hunks.sol: The endless army of the Demonic Cult surging toward them.

hunks.sol: Dark Heaven had annihilated the Demonic Cult’s army, then proposed a deal.

hunks.sol: It meant having a gu planted in their heads, but they would have done anything for revenge.[^2]

hunks.sol: At the same time, his bloodstained hand pressed against Jin Chung’s chest.

hunks.baseline: A small explosion went off inside Jin Chung's body.
hunks.sol: A small explosion went off inside Jin Chung’s body.

hunks.baseline: The energy burst his eardrums, severed his blood vessels strand by strand, and reached his heart.
hunks.sol: The energy burst his eardrums, tore his blood vessels apart strand by strand, and reached his heart.

hunks.sol: Jin Chung’s lifeless body flew like a bird and plunged off the cliff.

hunks.baseline: “Ouch. That must've hurt.”
hunks.sol: “Ouch. That must’ve hurt.”

hunks.sol: Ten black-clad men who had appeared out of nowhere were massacring the Gunggui Sect’s disciples.

hunks.baseline: “Let's finish this quickly and go.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s finish this quickly and go.”

hunks.sol: Screams erupted all around him, but below the cliff, the air was filled with cheers and shouts.

hunks.sol: But Jin Taekyung’s appearance had been a variable even he had not anticipated.

hunks.baseline: His deepening gaze turned toward Jin Taekyung, ringed by cheers.
hunks.sol: His darkening gaze settled on Jin Taekyung, ringed by cheering men.

hunks.baseline: “Let go! Let go, you bastard!”
hunks.sol: “Let go! Let go, you idiot!”

hunks.sol: *I’ll let you live. For today.*
